==English==
{{wp}}

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|præference||obsolete}}

===Etymology 1===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*bʰer-}}
From {{der|en|frm|preference}}, from {{der|en|la-med|-}} {{m|la|preferentia}}. {{doublet|en|preferans}}. Morphologically {{suffix|en|prefer|ence}}. Compare typologically {{m+|ru|предвзя́тость}} (<< {{m|ru|взять}}, a suppletive of {{m|ru|брать}}, which is cognate with {{m+|la|ferō}}).

====Pronunciation====
* {{IPA|en|/ˈpɹɛf(ə)ɹ(ə)ns/|/ˈpɹɛf(ə)ɹɛns/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-preference.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɛfəɹəns|s=3}}

====Noun====
{{en-noun|~}}

# The [[selection]] of one thing or person over others (with the main [[adposition]] being "[[for]]" in relation to the thing or person, but possibly also "[[of]]")
#: {{syn|en|druthers|way}} 
#: {{ux|en|He has a '''preference''' for crisp wines.}}
# The [[option]] to so [[select]], and the one [[selected]].
#: {{ux|en|Can I keep my '''preferences''' when I upgrade to the new version of this application?}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-06-14|author=w:Jonathan Freedland
|volume=189|issue=1|page=18|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly
|title=[http://www.guardian.co.uk/commentisfree/2013/jun/07/obama-apple-google-facebook-tainted-prism Obama's once hip brand is now tainted]
|passage=Where we once sent love letters in a sealed envelope, or stuck photographs of our children in a family album, now such private material is despatched to servers and clouds operated by people we don't know and will never meet. Perhaps we assume that our name, address and search '''preferences''' will be viewed by some unseen pair of corporate eyes, probably not human, and don't mind that much.}}
# The state of being [[preferred]] over others.
# A strong [[liking]] or personal [[valuation]].
# A [[preferential]] [[bias]]; [[partiality]]; [[discrimination]].

=====Synonyms=====
* {{l|en|forechoice}}
* {{sense|preferential bias}} see [[Thesaurus:predilection]]
